Nothing unbinds GUA or GMalloc on a later seed refusal.
Q1_seed_order.boot_path_note: With the staged settings (no DoEarlyScan key; default false, SettingsManager.hpp:43) ScanGame runs exactly ONCE, from UnrealInitializer::Initialize at 1644-1647, inside the PROSPERO try at 1654 whose only catch is DisarmLayoutGate+rethrow (2241-2248). The runtime_error swallow at UE4SSProgram.cpp:1329-1332 belongs to the DoEarlyScan early-scan call site and is DEAD on this configuration. So a pool refusal in this boot propagates: it cannot coexist with a healthy continuing startup.

Q2_stopping_for_uninstall.claim: 'Stopping mod X for uninstall' is the first log line of LuaMod::uninstall(). On PROSPERO it is reached only through UE4SSProgram::uninstall_mods() -> mod->uninstall(), and uninstall_mods() runs only inside shutdown_native_program() (plus the explicit queue_uninstall_mod* flows, which are event-driven and not in this log shape). It is NOT a seeds-refusal-to-mod-loader signal and NOT caused by the 'Mod is absent' error; the seeds refusal reaches it only by aborting init() into the shared shutdown path.

Q4_read_path.claim: NativeModSource::read() matches EXACT UTF-8 logical keys below ue4ss/ (the loadlist-staged file-table strings), never filesystem paths. After the path fix, read() returns the Lua bytes iff normalize_path_for_lua(m_scripts_path/'main.lua') reproduces the staged key byte-for-byte, which for pure-ASCII paths it does.
